__inputs.name: DS_MORPHEUS
__inputs.label: Morpheus (Infinity)
__inputs.description: Infinity data source pointing at Morpheus

__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS_MORPHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus (Morpheus json-exporter)
__inputs.description: Prometheus that scrapes this Morpheus through json-exporter

targets.expr: (max by (server, server_id) (last_over_time(morpheus_server_power_on_state{cloud="${cloud:text}", server_type!~".*Hypervisor"}[5m]))) or (0 * max by (server, server_id) (last_over_time(morpheus_server_memory_max_bytes{cloud="${cloud:text}", server_type!~".*Hypervisor"}[5m])))

panels.title: ${cloud:text}
panels.description: VMs of this cloud from Prometheus (json-exporter reading /api/servers). Each value is the last agent sample within 5 minutes, so it does not drop out when the hypervisor poll overwrites the latest sample in Morpheus. Power is 'off' for a VM that reports no power state but still has a memory size.
